title: Scammers impersonate ShinyHunters in new sextortion email campaign
summary: Following insights from Bleeping Computer, threat actors are leveraging email addresses exposed in data breaches, previously leaked by the ShinyHunters extortion group, to perpetrate a new sextortion email campaign demanding $2,000 in Bitcoin.
why_it_matters: Breaches and cybercrime activity signal where attackers are focusing and what data types are actively monetized.
recommendation: Validate incident-response readiness, monitor for exposed credentials, and reinforce MFA, phishing resistance, and data-loss controls.
